measurement, behavioural economics and applied econometrics. I am open to new
students.

## Before you write to me

Most enquiries I receive could be answered from a template, and I answer those
with a template. The ones I answer properly do three things.

**Name a question, not a field.** "I want to work on health economics" tells me
nothing. "I want to know whether patients in this setting weigh X against Y the
way clinical guidelines assume" tells me whether I can help.

**Say why me.** Point to a specific paper or tool of mine and what you would do
next with it. If nothing of mine connects to your question, I am probably the
wrong supervisor, and you will be glad to have found that out early.

**Attach the evidence.** CV with qualifications and results, any publications, and
English language results if relevant.

Send it to [mesfin.genie@newcastle.edu.au](mailto:mesfin.genie@newcastle.edu.au).
I read everything that meets those three conditions.

## Admission and funding

Admission and scholarships at Newcastle run through the University's Higher Degree
by Research process on its own timetable, separately from my agreement to
supervise. Check the University's
[research degree pages](https://www.newcastle.edu.au/research-and-innovation/graduate-research)
for current deadlines before planning around a start date.
